claim_text: Resource limitation rewires ploidy evolution through opposing chromosome-content costs and buffering advantages.
panel_goal: State the manuscript thesis as a compact mechanism overview.
visual_form: Summary schematic linking resource stress to chromosome-content cost, CIN/WGD pressure, and high-ploidy missegregation buffering.

claim_text: Matched SUM159 near-2N and near-4N lineages enable environment-dependent in vitro/in vivo comparison.
panel_goal: Show why the comparison is interpretable across culture and tumor contexts.
visual_form: Timeline/data-stream panel showing the same 2N/4N starting system split into in vitro and in vivo measurements.

claim_text: Resource limitation can both oppose and promote high ploidy.
panel_goal: Define the opposing model mechanisms that make ploidy outcomes context dependent.
visual_form: Mechanism schematic: chromosome-content cost and stress death oppose high ploidy while CIN/WGD generation and survival buffering can preserve or create high ploidy.

claim_text: The tumor setting is broader than lower oxygen and should be interpreted as an effective in vivo resource-stress regime.
panel_goal: Prevent literal overinterpretation of oxygen as the only in vivo stress variable.
visual_form: In vivo versus in vitro stress-context schematic contrasting fixed known O2 in culture with effective tumor resource stress.

claim_text: Joint soft-coupled fits infer context-specific proliferation, CIN, and survival-filter axes between in vivo and in vitro.
panel_goal: Show the inferred axes that differ between contexts.
visual_form: Paired parameter or ratio forest plot comparing in vivo and in vitro soft-coupled axes: proliferative ceiling, stress-linked missegregation, and ploidy-dependent survival filtering.

claim_text: Dominant ploidy state is resource-regime dependent.
panel_goal: Organize fixed-O2 behavior into low, intermediate, and high resource regimes.
visual_form: Fixed-O2 regime panel with low/intermediate/high O2 bands and dominant drivers annotated.

claim_text: Multiple fitted solution regions may represent distinct biological regimes rather than purely optimizer noise.
panel_goal: Show that fitted solutions occupy structured parameter regions with candidate biological interpretations.
visual_form: Prior-aware parameter-landscape plot with clusters or regions, representative fixed-O2 curve classes, and candidate regime labels.

claim_text: Separate in vitro fits show oxygen reshapes ploidy without requiring strong high-ploidy elimination.
panel_goal: Summarize the in vitro-only fit as a permissive culture regime with weak direct high-ploidy burden effects.
visual_form: In vitro fit panel showing growth and ploidy trajectories with weak lower-bound high-ploidy growth-penalty parameters annotated.

claim_text: In vitro ploidy reduction can arise from CIN-generated variation plus ploidy-dependent missegregation survival buffering.
panel_goal: Explain how downward chromosome-number reshaping can coexist with high-ploidy persistence in vitro.
visual_form: Mechanistic trajectory panel showing high-ploidy cells missegregating more often, viable chromosome-loss daughters, and downward ploidy movement.

claim_text: Separate in vivo fits provide the in vivo side of the context comparison by testing tumor burden and terminal ploidy/necrosis constraints.
panel_goal: Add a conservative in vivo-fit bridge between separate-fit panels and the joint in vivo/in vitro comparison.
visual_form: Separate in vivo fit panel comparing observed and fitted tumor burden trajectories with terminal ploidy and necrosis constraint summaries, keyed to the in_vivo_top_10 report set.

claim_text: Steady-state ploidy mode is predictable from fitted parameters, but predictability depends on O2/resource level.
panel_goal: Quantify how well fitted parameters discriminate ploidy mode across resource levels.
visual_form: AUC-by-O2 panel with top single parameters or small feature sets annotated.

claim_text: Low-resource ploidy behavior is mainly death dominated.
panel_goal: Show the low-O2 driver of Mode 1 versus Mode 2 behavior.
visual_form: Low-O2 feature-importance or coefficient panel emphasizing stress-associated death scale and death-reduction benefit.

claim_text: Intermediate-resource behavior is the least reducible and most tradeoff dependent.
panel_goal: Show that intermediate O2 depends on multi-parameter tradeoffs rather than one dominant axis.
visual_form: Intermediate-O2 interaction or multi-feature panel covering death selectivity, missegregation sensitivity, buffering, thresholding, and baseline missegregation.

claim_text: High-resource ploidy behavior is mainly governed by baseline missegregation, with buffering modifying the outcome.
panel_goal: Show how ongoing missegregation and buffering dominate when death pressure is reduced.
visual_form: High-O2 feature panel emphasizing p_mis_base or baseline missegregation terms and buffering strength.

claim_text: Continuous dominant-ploidy analyses support the discrete mode analyses.
panel_goal: Check that binary mode labels are consistent with continuous dominant-ploidy behavior.
visual_form: Side-by-side scatter or calibration plot comparing continuous dominant ploidy with Mode 1/Mode 2 classification.

claim_text: Full fixed-O2 ploidy-response curve classes provide a richer phenotype than binary mode labels.
panel_goal: Show that curve classes add structure beyond the binary mode readout.
visual_form: Curve-class panel across the fixed-O2 grid showing nonmonotone, monotone, U-shaped, inverted-U-shaped, flat, and transition-plateau classes.

claim_text: Oxygen is an informative but incomplete proxy for resource limitation.
panel_goal: Record the interpretation limit linking model oxygen to broader tumor resource stress.
visual_form: Conceptual limitation schematic showing oxygen as the formal variable nested within nutrient, perfusion, waste, density, stromal, and tissue-structure constraints.

claim_text: CIN-inducing therapies may have ploidy-dependent effects under the survival-filter framework.
panel_goal: Separate therapeutic implication from primary result unless direct drug-response data are included.
visual_form: Prediction schematic contrasting near-diploid sensitivity to missegregation dosage imbalance with high-ploidy buffering of chromosome gains or losses.

claim_text: The current in vitro fit does not prove that division rate is ploidy independent.
panel_goal: State the ablation needed before making a ploidy-independent division-rate claim.
visual_form: Ablation-design panel comparing the current weak-penalty model with a ploidy-neutral division-rate refit or fully neutral alpha_o2/gamma_growth variant.

claim_text: Fixed-O2 attractor analyses and finite-time experimental trajectories are related but not identical.
panel_goal: Clarify how long-time fixed-O2 attractors should be interpreted relative to measured trajectories.
visual_form: Methods schematic contrasting dominant-eigenvector fixed-O2 attractor behavior with finite-time experimental trajectory constraints.

claim_text: Parameter-landscape analyses need prior-aware preprocessing before PCA, UMAP, t-SNE, or clustering are interpreted biologically.
panel_goal: Document the preprocessing requirement behind landscape interpretation.
visual_form: Workflow panel showing transformed/scaled prior-aware vectors feeding PCA/UMAP/t-SNE and cluster characterization in original or derived feature space.

claim_text: Model-implied biological features help translate fitted parameters into interpretable regimes.
panel_goal: Bridge raw fitted parameters to biological regime labels.
visual_form: Derived-feature overlay panel for net growth, turnover, death/proliferation balance, O2 thresholds, missegregation burden, post-missegregation viability, and effective oxygen supply regime.

claim_text: Default soft-coupling settings and parameter lists affect comparability across joint-fit runs.
panel_goal: Make the joint-fit provenance assumptions visible before comparing runs.
visual_form: Provenance table or schematic listing soft-coupling settings, parameter lists, and branch/config compatibility.

claim_text: Start tables and bound expansion can silently change the optimizer region.
panel_goal: Record optimizer-region provenance for parameter-landscape analyses.
visual_form: Traceability panel showing start-table source, bound expansion status, and resulting feasible parameter region.

claim_text: The manuscript description of dead compartments should match the implementation.
panel_goal: Ensure the mechanism diagram names nonviable CIN-associated compartments correctly.
visual_form: Model-routing schematic showing boundary-dropped ordinary missegregation daughters and out-of-grid WGD events entering the CIN-associated or boundary/nonviability-associated dead compartment.

claim_text: The manuscript-described analysis should match the default implementation, including warm-start initialization when used.
panel_goal: Keep the analysis description consistent with the executed fitting workflow.
visual_form: Run-provenance panel indicating warm-start initialization, analyzed config, and whether the manuscript workflow is default or explicitly specified.
